// Import the pillarbox library import pillarbox from '@srgssr/pillarbox-web'; // The same program in its standard and signed versions const STANDARD_URN = 'urn:rts:video:9ef30a42-26a4-339c-852e-701fdf21911c'; const SIGNED_URN = 'urn:rts:video:e2e7fc74-c321-36c4-8354-998797cc0139'; const Button = pillarbox.getComponent('Button'); // A control bar button to toggle between the standard and signed versions class SignLanguageButton extends Button { #signed = false; constructor(player, options) { super(player, options); this.#updateState(); } // The icon is drawn in CSS through the pbw-sign-language-button class buildCSSClass() { return `pbw-sign-language-button ${super.buildCSSClass()}`; } handleClick() { this.#signed = !this.#signed; this.#updateState(); this.#switchSource(this.#signed ? SIGNED_URN : STANDARD_URN); } // Keep the label and pressed state in sync for assistive technologies #updateState() { this.controlText(this.#signed ? 'Watch without sign language' : 'Watch in sign language'); this.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(this.#signed)); this.toggleClass('pbw-sign-language-active', this.#signed); } // Load the other version and resume playback at the same position #switchSource(urn) { const player = this.player(); const currentTime = player.currentTime(); const wasPlaying = !player.paused(); // Using loadeddata instead of loadedmetadata because of // https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=261512 player.one('loadeddata', () => { player.currentTime(currentTime); }); player.src({ src: urn, type: 'srgssr/urn' }); if (wasPlaying) player.play(); } } pillarbox.registerComponent('SignLanguageButton', SignLanguageButton); const player = pillarbox('video-element-id', { fill: true }); // Add the button to the control bar, just before the fullscreen toggle const controlBar = player.getChild('ControlBar'); const fullscreenIndex = controlBar.children().indexOf(controlBar.getChild('FullscreenToggle')); controlBar.addChild('SignLanguageButton', {}, fullscreenIndex); player.src({ src: STANDARD_URN, type: 'srgssr/urn' });
